card.text: Red dwarf 178 parsecs away that hosts Kepler-186 f.

introduction.text: Kepler-186 is a red dwarf 178 parsecs away, about half the Sun’s radius. Its outermost known planet, Kepler-186 f, circles it every 130 days.
